values.note: NPS: 'Due to impacts for Hurricane Helene, Crabtree Falls Campground will be closed to all camping in 2026.' No reopening date published; recreation.gov shows every site 'Closed' in October 2026 and 'Not Available' for April-May 2027. Parkway road status (Oct 2026): 'Crabtree Falls Campground closed. Crabtree Falls Picnic Area open. Hiking is PROHIBITED at Crabtree Falls due to Helene related damage.'

status.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/crabtree-falls-cg.htm ('CLOSED', 'Due to impacts for Hurricane Helene, Crabtree Falls Campground will be closed to all camping in 2026', Operating Hours: 'Due to impacts from Hurricane Helene - Closed for 2026') + https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/roadclosures.htm (MP 333.9-342.1 row) + recreation.gov availability, read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/crabtree-falls-cg.htm ('Electric Hookups: 0', 'The campground has a dump station and potable water, but NO water or electric hookups') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/258667 ('No electric, water, or sewer hook-ups are available.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 81 sites, 18 of them RV-only; 27 reservable and 54 first-come. RIDB lists a max vehicle length for only 19 sites (25 to 55 ft; 13 pull-throughs). Most sites take one vehicle.

sites.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/crabtree-falls-cg.htm ('TOTAL SITES: 81', 'RV Only: 18') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/258667 ('In addition to the 27 sites available for advance reservations, 54 campsites are available on a first come, first served basis', 'Most sites are limited to only one vehicle') + RIDB catalog (Max Vehicle Length 25-55, Driveway Entry Pull-through 13), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Flush toilets, dump station and drinking water are seasonal. No cell reception or internet. Firewood sold seasonally; food storage lockers.

facilities.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/crabtree-falls-cg.htm (Toilet Types 'Flush Toilets - seasonal', Shower Types 'None', 'Dump Station Yes, Seasonal', 'Potable Water - Seasonal', 'Camp Store No', 'Laundry No', 'Cell Phone Reception No') + recreation.gov ('There are no showers'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Operated by the NPS (not a concession). 27 sites reservable up to six months ahead on recreation.gov or (877) 444-6777; 54 first-come sites are 'booked in person at the campground kiosk' and are not tracked online. Campground phone 828-675-5444 (May - October).

booking.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/crabtree-falls-cg.htm ('Campsites are available on a first-come, first-served basis. In addition, advance reservations can be made for some campsites up to six months in advance by visiting www.recreation.gov') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/258667 (description; is_commercially_managed false; facility_phone '828-675-5444 (MAY - OCTOBER)'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/crabtree-falls-cg.htm (Fees: 'Holders of the Interagency Senior, Access, Golden Age, or Golden Access passes are entitled to a 50% discount on the base fee'), read 2026-10-22

note:
High-elevation Blue Ridge Parkway campground in a wooded mountain setting.  --AWH
Hiking at Crabtree Falls is prohibited for Helene damage (NPS, October 2026); the picnic area is open. --Claude

awh_superseded.old: Closed for 2026 due to hurricane Helene

summary: NPS page and recreation.gov: confirmed closed to all camping in 2026 (Helene), now from NPS; cleared the derived reopens '2027' (no date published; rec.gov has April-May 2027 'Not Available'). Added no water/electric/sewer hookups, 81 sites (18 RV-only, 27 reservable + 54 FCFS) to 55 ft with pull-throughs, flush toilets/dump/water (seasonal), no showers, rec.gov 6-month window, senior pass 50%. Fees ($30) stand. The Parkway is open past the campground (MP 333.9-342.1). Not stated: season dates (phone listed May-October).
flags: Status re-confirmed: NPS says Crabtree Falls Campground 'will be closed to all camping in 2026' after Hurricane Helene; no reopening date published, so the derived reopens '2027' was cleared. Needs a re-check early in 2027.
Missing phone: the campground's seasonal number is 828-675-5444 (May-October, recreation.gov); Blue Ridge Parkway information 828-348-3400.
